tier_reason: README Benchmarks section has first-party picobench tables of lwlog vs spdlog for sync, sync-buffered, async blocking and async nonblocking modes; no compiler, flags or CPU are stated, so C.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Sync: 12268.1 vs 1651.5 ops/s at 8 msgs (7.4x), 2.5x at 8192; sync buffered (lwlog) vs spdlog sync 319x at 8 msgs, 237x at 8192; async blocking 16.3x at 8 msgs and 539.9x at 4096 (spdlog row 565498 ns/op); async nonblocking 20.7x at 8 msgs falling to 2.4x at 8192.
corrections.caveats: No compiler, flags or hardware stated; the 539x row is async blocking at 4096 msgs, where spdlog's queue appears to saturate; buffered lwlog is compared against unbuffered spdlog, so the 237-319x ratios compare different buffering semantics; sync ns/op values (81-112 us per message) suggest a flushing sink; not independently reproduced.

notes: Numbers match the README. The 539x figure belongs to the async blocking table, not async nonblocking as the record said. Last commit 2025-12-25 is under 12 months old, so active rather than stale.
